description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related functions for retrieving system information such as CPU load, memory, architecture, and hostname across different operating systems (Linux, macOS, Windows). It also includes functions for setting environment variables and rebooting the system.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides system information such as hostname, CPU load, memory, architecture, and firmware version. Implements singleton pattern and platform-specific system info retrieval.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Reads and stores memory information from /proc/meminfo on Linux systems.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Id
methods.description: Generates a unique system ID based on device ID and system prefix.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SystemInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes system information such as hostname and CPU stats.

methods.name: SystemInfo::UpdateCpuStats
methods.description: Updates CPU load statistics based on platform-specific data sources.

methods.name: SystemInfo::UpdateRealtimeInfo
methods.description: Updates real-time system information such as memory and uptime.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetTime
methods.description: Sets the system time based on provided Time object.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the system timezone environment variable.

methods.name: SystemInfo::GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets or unsets an environment variable.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SystemInfo.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Chipset
methods.description: Returns the chipset information from /proc/cpuinfo or system calls.

methods.name: SystemInfo::FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the firmware version or kernel release.
